benign-api.observed: a programmatic client on one port

benign-retry.observed: a flaky link retrying; retry_observations distinguishes a retransmission from a fresh attempt

benign-truncated.observed: ordinary browsing through a truncated capture
benign-truncated.not_observed: payload-derived evidence unavailable, exactly as for probe-truncated. The pair exists so a truncated capture cannot become a proxy for guilt

benign-web-burst.observed: a page pulling many assets at once

composite-credential-spray.observed: credential-shaped requests spread across several addresses and services. Request shape and destination breadth are both visible

composite-decoy-recon.observed: decoy contact followed by service enumeration. Both halves are ours to see: the decoy is this host-s and the ports are this host-s

composite-paced-breadth.observed: slow pacing, wide port breadth and several addresses of this host at once. Every component reaches the sensor: ports, destinations and the 900 s span
composite-paced-breadth.not_observed: nothing relevant. Withholding rate is the test, not a limitation

credential-automation.observed: credential_attempts from request shape, never content

credential-low-rate.observed: the same credential shapes under a rate threshold; the evidence is persistence and repetition rather than rate

deception-enumeration.observed: contact with a decoy port that exists only to be contacted. The single cleanest signal available to this sensor

hard-negative-admin.observed: an administrator touching several services in one sitting: real port breadth, legitimately

hard-negative-backup.observed: sustained volume to one service with every exchange completed. The control for the connections_60s term added in P15.3

hard-negative-batch-api.observed: authenticated batch jobs in bursts. The control for the credential term: a real API client authenticates constantly

hard-negative-connect.observed: a connect probe that completes and leaves

hard-negative-crawler.observed: a polite crawler across several addresses of one site. The control for the destination-breadth re-normalisation added in P15.3

hard-negative-deception.observed: brushing past a decoy without enumerating it. The control that stops "touched a decoy" from becoming a signature

hard-negative-discovery.observed: service discovery, which is breadth with a good reason

hard-negative-health-check.observed: high-rate periodic checking from a load balancer

hard-negative-monitoring.observed: a metronomic agent: the most regular timing on the network and entirely legitimate. The reason a timing term may never be sufficient alone

probe-enumeration.observed: distinct service probes: unique_protocol_probes and probe_family_diversity

probe-repeated.observed: the same probe body repeated: max_probe_repetition over payload digests, plus inter-arrival regularity and incomplete connection attempts
probe-repeated.not_observed: deliberately close to a monitoring agent; separating the two needs more than repetition alone, and that is an evidence problem rather than a visibility one

probe-truncated.observed: the same behaviour as probe-repeated seen through a truncated capture: timing, ports, addresses and connection attempts all survive
probe-truncated.not_observed: the payload is cut by snaplen, so payload digests, credential shapes and protocol-family classification are unavailable BY CONSTRUCTION. Any evidence family that depends on payload content cannot contribute

protocol-mismatch.observed: protocol_anomalies: a request shaped for one service sent to another

recon-multi-stage.observed: breadth then focus, across the 900 s window; several families react

scan-burst.observed: port breadth in bursts; burst fraction and interval variance both react

scan-connect.observed: completed connections across ports; handshake completion is counted

scan-horizontal.observed: one service across several addresses OF THIS HOST. SENSOR_ADDRESSES are the monitored host-s own addresses, so unique_destinations counts them and the traffic crosses this sensor-s capture path
scan-horizontal.not_observed: breadth across hosts this sensor does not protect is invisible, and a real horizontal sweep of an unrelated network would be OUT_OF_SCOPE

scan-randomized.observed: port breadth without sequence: unique_destination_ports reacts, sequential_port_fraction deliberately does not

scan-sequential.observed: consecutive destination ports on one host: unique_destination_ports and sequential_port_fraction both react

scan-slow.observed: port breadth accumulated over the 900 s window; persistence and ports_900s are the evidence, not rate

note: classified from the sensor architecture, before the P15.3 locked corpus existed. Detection difficulty is not a reason to reclassify
